title: Russell US Style indexes — conditional capping check effective at the open of 2027-03-31 (24% / 4.8%-above-48% test struck on the 2027-03-25 close, Good Friday shifting T-3 back a day)
source: EST: owner-published standing rule, read direct by this proposer rather than inherited. FTSE Russell, "Capping Methodology Guide", v5.4, September 2026 (lseg.com dam policy-documents, capping-methodology-guide.pdf, HTTP 200, 652,008 bytes, 62 content streams inflated and text-extracted in-session 2026-09-08): every Russell US Style row in section 4.8.6 gives price date "T-3", effective date "Last business day of each month", trigger "No company is greater than 24%, and all companies that have a weight greater than 4.8% in aggregate are no more than 48% of the index", scheme "Rule 4.2/RIC 22.5/45". The March instance is a quarter-end under BOTH readings of the owner's disputed frequency wording (the guide's "Monthly" and the July 2026 FAQ's "conducted quarterly (March, June, September, and December)"), so unlike a bare month-end it needs no position on that conflict. THE 2027 DATE IS RULE-DERIVED, NOT PUBLISHED -- the FAQ's dated schedule table carries 2026 rows only. Last business day of March 2027 is Wednesday 2027-03-31; T-3 steps back over Good Friday 2027-03-26 (a full NYSE closure -- nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct 2026-09-08, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, corroborated by this repo's src/domain/market-calendar.ts) to Thursday 2027-03-25. The same T-3 arithmetic reproduced all four of the owner's published 2026 cut-off dates to the day in the 2026-09-30 sibling's session, including the holiday-aware December one. Filed estimate because a proposal is always estimate by contract, because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and because the confirmed-tier prefixes have no member for an index owner's own published methodology. Discovered during the russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-06-30 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: DISCOVERED during the russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-06-30 initial research (2026-09-08), and proposed because it is LOAD-BEARING ON THE PROPOSER'S OWN NUMBER rather than swept up by habit. That research found June to be the one quarter whose style capping review takes effect AFTER the quarter-end test's own price date (review effective open 2027-06-28 against a test struck on the 2027-06-25 close), which means the June test reads an index the June review has not yet recapped. Under the July 2026 FAQ's quarterly reading of the check's frequency, THIS March instance is then the last reset that can bind the June test at all -- and the proposer measured the difference at 512/1,179 = 43.43% (only this March check resets) against 223/1,179 = 18.91% (the guide's monthly reading, where April and May month-end checks also reset). A calendar that tracks June without tracking March cannot tell those apart. Note the asymmetry with the March/September/December instances generally: THIS one behaves normally -- the March 2027 style capping review is effective at the open of Monday 2027-03-22 (the Monday after the third Friday, cut-off Wednesday 2027-03-10 by the same convention that reproduces all four published 2026 columns), which PRECEDES the 2027-03-25 test, giving an 11-session drift window and a 83/1,242 = 6.68% base rate on the proposer's own five-year bar set. Impact low and symbols deliberately EMPTY, following the family's measured reasoning rather than re-deriving it: no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (0 hits, re-grepped 2026-09-08), a fired recap moves roughly $478M across five of the most liquid names on the tape, and an ETF proxy in symbols would make the deterministic screen trip on mega-cap beta. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
